title: 大阪杯の後に・Just a Dream…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion manages another incredible run at the Osaka Hai, but her usual joy from racing has gone…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Realizing that she's facing more pressure than even she can play down, Fine Motion opens up to me and shares her true feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's sad that her fun is almost over, and that the time she's spent in Japan—which feels like a dream come true—is going to vanish as if it were a dream. It also pains her to think that everyone might forget her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion smiles as if a weight has been lifted from her after opening up about her feelings. But I wonder whether it's a good idea for us to go on like this…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Harboring mixed feelings, the both of us prepare for the next race—the Takarazuka Kinen, a Grand Prix race where entrants are selected by fan vote.
